greeting-time.text: Good evening, and welcome. I'd be happy to help with your table request. What time would you prefer?

check.text: Thank you. Let me check the sample availability. This is a demonstration, so a host would confirm your request.

available-1900.text: There is a sample option at seven p.m. A member of staff would verify availability before confirming your table.

available-2000.text: There is a sample option at eight p.m. A member of staff would verify availability before confirming your table.

unavailable.text: I'm sorry, that time isn't available in this sample. Our host would be happy to help you find another option.

large-party.text: For a larger party, I'd ask our host to help with seating arrangements. Your request would need a personal review before anything is confirmed.

greeting-info.text: Hello, and welcome. I'd be happy to help with restaurant information or a table request. What would you like to know?

information.text: For this sample restaurant, evening tables are shown between six thirty and eight p.m. Menu details, opening hours, and accessibility would be confirmed by the restaurant team.

guest-count.text: How many guests will be joining you? If anyone has a dietary or accessibility request, our host can help you plan your visit.

occasion.text: That sounds lovely. I'll include a birthday note in the sample request. Our host would confirm any special arrangements with you personally.

handoff.text: Of course. In a connected service, I would pass your request to a host now. This demonstration stops at a handoff preview, so no call is transferred.

closing.text: Thank you for speaking with us. Your sample request remains unconfirmed. Our team would review the details before getting back to you. Have a lovely evening.

summary-general.text: Your sample request is shown in the transcript. A host would review the guest count, time, and any special arrangements before confirming. Nothing has been booked.
